contract.inference: High-level file sends/edits infer JPEG/PNG photos, registered MIME and filename/audio/video attributes. Explicit forceDocument/asImage/MIME/attributes retain caller control. Raw TL InputFile shortcuts remain documents.
contract.metadata: Both SDK styles and canonical operations share flags, exact detached references, thumbnail preparation and all-item preflight. Album uploadMedia retains reusable flags and live-photo video references.
contract.uploads: One to sixteen finite concurrent parts, ordered checksum/encryption preparation, fractional SDK progress beside canonical byte progress, cancellation and shared cleanup failure retention.
contract.bounds: At most ten album items, 1000 supplied attributes/stickers, 256 KiB per supplied metadata value, 64 MiB default upload limit and sixteen half-MiB in-flight parts.

differences: Owned uploads preserve real MD5 checksums; the pinned GramJS helper returns an empty checksum. Thumbnail comparison first asserts that difference and then normalizes only the checksum.
Owned video notes use round-video attributes without the pinned SDK helper accidental voice-audio attribute. Explicit supplied attributes still override inferred attributes.
Owned URL filename inference excludes query/fragment components; pinned helpers inspect unparsed strings.

Owned upload workers are finite (1..16) and honor progress callbacks asynchronously. Default upload size remains bounded; explicit metadata controls actual duration/dimensions because pinned helpers do not parse binary metadata.
Current flags on historical SDK schemas still depend on the older-schema bridge; common supported metadata is verified on all five selected adapters.
